title: Designer wireframe spec
description: Screens as a tree of library components, for `designer wf build`. Reference: https://github.com/henriquefps/logo-designer/blob/main/docs/wireframe-spec.md

Node.description: A node: a library component, a container, a shared component instance, a plain group or a raw project object.

node.description: A node as stored in a project file (designer-project.schema.json).

anyOf.description: No stack: content placed freely (x / y).

FrameLayout.description: Root layout of a frame (default: a vertical stack with the platform's padding and gap).

Screen.description: A logical screen: one frame (platform, root… on the screen) or several (variants).

from.description: A node id or a path: "Settings/Language", "Settings@tablet/Language".

on.description: A node id or path (absent: a free note).

repeat.description: Repeat the first child N times (a list of anything).
Repeat the first child N times (a list of anything).
Repeat the first child N times (a list of anything).

label.description: Label. With a label the button is extended (a pill).

bodyLines.description: Body lines. Grey bars for the description (0 = none).

label.description: Label. A short word in the middle, like "or".

message.default: Items you add will show up here.

buttonLabel.description: Button. Leave empty for no button.

fields.description: Fields. Label of each input, in reading order.

selected.description: Selected option. Position in the list, starting at 1 (0 = none selected).

value.description: Value. Text already typed in. Empty shows the placeholder.
Selected value. Empty shows the placeholder.

options.description: Options. Not drawn (the menu is closed); read by the AI export.

value.description: Value. Text already typed in. Empty shows the placeholder.
Value. Text already typed in. Empty shows the placeholder.

icon.description: Leading icon. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

columns.description: Columns. Heading of each column of links.

legal.description: Legal row. Copyright line at the bottom.

action.description: Action. Text on the right, e.g. "See all".

subject.description: What it shows. Not drawn; the AI export reads it.

icon1.description: Icon, tab 1. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

icon2.description: Icon, tab 2. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

icon3.description: Icon, tab 3. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

icon4.description: Icon, tab 4. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

icon5.description: Icon, tab 5. An icon name: "heart", "lucide:Heart", "ph:heart" ('' = none).

items.description: Items. The last one is the current page.

selected.description: Selected link. Position in the list, starting at 1.

actions.description: Actions. Buttons on the right; the last one is filled.

title.description: Title. App or section name above the items.

items.description: Items. Start an entry with # to make it a section label.

selected.description: Selected item. Position among the items (not the labels), starting at 1.

actions.description: Actions. How many icons on the right (0–3).

large.description: Large title. The title sits on its own line under the icons.

message.default: This photo will be removed from all your albums.

secondary.description: Other action. Leave empty for a dialog with one action.

text.default: Body text. Replace it with the words this screen needs.

common.id.description: Stable id (dump writes one for every node; build --into updates the node with this id).

common.name.description: Layer name (default: the component label / container kind).

common.width.description: Width in its stack: "fill", "hug" or px (default: the component's sizing).

common.height.description: Height in its stack: "fill", "hug" or px (only for components with a resizable height).

common.position.description: "flow" (default), "pinned-bottom" (screen children: bottom bars) or "free" (absolute, x / y).

common.bleed.description: Edge to edge: ignore the stack's side padding.

common.x.description: Free / unstacked nodes: left in the parent.

common.y.description: Free / unstacked nodes: top in the parent.

common.size.description: Box of a node no layout places (free, in a free screen).

common.note.description: A note attached to this node.
